hero.headline:
Come for the land.
Stay for the stories.
hero.subhead: Discover working farms, seasonal traditions and warm village stays—directly from the people who call rural India home.

story.heading:
Meet the hands
behind the harvest.
story.paragraph: AgriTrails connects curious city travellers with farming families across rural India. Stay a little slower, learn something real, and make sure your money goes where it matters.

calendar.heading: What's in season.
calendar.subhead: Plan your farm stay around live harvest cycles and seasonal activities across India.

promise.heading: Every booking helps a farm thrive.
promise.paragraph: We keep it simple: no commissions hidden from farmers, no mass-produced experiences. Just a direct connection and a little more good in the world.

trust.badgeTitle: Verified by AgriTrails · Click to read verification details
trust.modalIntro: Every stay carrying this badge has undergone in-person validation by the AgriTrails field team to ensure safe, authentic rural visits.
trust.hostIdentityTitle: Identity of the host checked by our team
trust.hostIdentityDesc: Our team personally visits the property, meets the host family face-to-face, and confirms primary residence on the farm.
trust.checklistTitle: Farm visit and safety checklist completed
trust.checklistDesc: Physical walkthrough conducted covering clean drinking water, private sanitary living spaces, secure access roads, and basic emergency provisions.
trust.contactDesc: Direct community reference and nearest primary healthcare access confirmed with local village elders.
trust.privacyNoteDesc: AgriTrails conducts direct, community-level field visits. We do not claim government database checks, and no government ID numbers, documents, or personal identity files are stored anywhere on our platform.
